<thought>The mass spectrum shows a protonated molecular ion at m/z ≈ 121.05, indicating a neutral mass of ~120.04 Da. The ¹H NMR displays five aromatic protons in two sets (2 H and 3 H), characteristic of a monosubstituted benzene ring. Combining these data points suggests a phenyl‑acetyl structure (acetophenone), whose exact neutral mass is 120.0575 Da and whose protonated ion appears at 121.0648 Da, matching the observed MS. The SMILES for acetophenone is “CC(=O)c1ccccc1”. This SMILES is valid and consistent with the spectral information. 

<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
